definitions.explanation: reading something while skipping over parts, either to save time or because of lack of interest in certain sections

examples.japanese: {飛|と}ばし{読|よ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{飛|と}ばし{読|よ}み⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I skimmed through it because I didn't have time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{飛|と}ばし{読|よ}み⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: It was a long novel, so I ended up skimming through it from partway.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧ (to skip) and ⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧ (reading). Describes the act of reading while intentionally skipping sections. Can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飛|と}ばし{読|よ}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to skim, to skip-read
- {飛|と}ばし{読|よ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to get by with skimming

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{読|よ}み→斜め読み：22744_nanameyomi⟧: skimming — literally "diagonal reading," a similar concept but implies scanning quickly rather than skipping sections
- ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧: speed reading — a systematic technique for reading quickly, not skipping content
- ⟦{拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}み→拾い読み：17927_hiroiyomi⟧: selective reading — picking out specific parts to read

USAGE:
Often carries a slightly negative connotation, implying that the reader did not give the text proper attention. In contrast, ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧ is seen as a positive skill.
